comments.author: chx
comments.story: I Quit Teaching Because of ChatGPT
comments.why: Explains why new media never replaced teaching
comments.text: Of course it has been a problem, I provided you with books from the 60s and the 70s to show a better way to educate people. See [VIDEO] for why TV or anything else didn't obsolete teaching.

comments.author: Kortaggio
comments.why: Argues education tech predictions keep failing
comments.text: Reminds me of "This Will Revolutionize Education: No prediction has been made as often, and as incorrectly as that." [VIDEO] The main problem is that learning is hard, and occurs inside the learner's head, rather than anything external outside of the learner.

comments.author: Hytosys
comments.why: History of technology repeatedly promised to revolutionize education
comments.text: We definitely have had a long history of "this changes everything for education!"[1], but 15 years is a long time for internet infrastructure to change and spread. The article seems to allude to such innovations. [1] [VIDEO]
